export_evidence: ImportKey company page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/fidicon-devices-india-private-limited) shows "Total Shipments 221 Records detected", "Trading Partners 17", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27" — but every visible row is an IMPORT INTO INDIA, e.g. "2026-02-27 | FIDICON DEVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | KUANG SIN CO.,LTD | BREATHER VALVE CUM FLAME ARRESTER ... | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Kaohsiung, TAIWAN | 84818049 | 1091543" and "2026-02-12 | FIDICON DEVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CONTROMAT LTD. | PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE ... | AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4, India | TEL AVIV YAFO, Israel | 84819090 | 9597781". Origin column = foreign country, destination column = Indian port, i.e. the company is the Indian BUYER/consignee, not the shipper. Top ports are all Indian inbound lanes ("TEL AVIV YAFO 24, AHEMDABAD AIR 19, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 12, AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4 9, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 5"). No outbound shipment row, no export bill of lading, no foreign consignee found. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 221 records; 5 rows rendered on the free view, all inbound.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved. The only address fragment visible is "PLOT NO. 1706, 12 GIDC" (Gujarat GIDC estate, consistent with the Ahmedabad/Ankleshwar customs lanes), which is a registered-address string, not supply evidence. thecompanycheck.com, trademo.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo returned connection refused and Bing returned unrelated results, so no domestic supply record was observed.
